question: Which aspects of Rāma protect the feet and the entire body?
premises: The giver of prosperity to Vibhīṣaṇa is invoked to protect the feet
Rāma is invoked to protect the entire body
inference: Rāma’s beneficent power extends protection to all parts of the body
plain_english: May the giver of prosperity to Vibhīṣaṇa protect the feet; may Rāma protect the entire body.
